parity_reason: No criterion differs by more than 1 and neither image has a critical defect, but the totals are A=20 and B=23, a gap of 3, which is more than 1.

reference.summary: Santa in a red suit rides a grey kick scooter over snow at night, gripping the handlebar with one hand and holding a stack of wrapped presents in the other, with speed lines and a moon; well drawn and lively.

defects.what: The rear fender arc sits behind and above the back wheel instead of over it, so it looks detached.
defects.where: the back wheel at the lower right
defects.expected: The fender curves tightly over the rear wheel and joins the deck.

defects.what: A black ball and the white glove overlap awkwardly where the stem meets the handlebar, so the grip is hard to read.
defects.where: the top of the scooter stem, upper left
defects.expected: The gloved hand clearly wraps around the handlebar grip with no stray shapes.

defects.what: The pink cheeks and nose overlap the beard edge, and the eyes are partly hidden under the hat brim.
defects.expected: Clear eyes below the brim and cheeks that sit neatly above the beard.

defects.what: The hand holding the presents only shows under the bottom box, so the stack looks like it is balancing instead of being held.
defects.where: the stack of presents at the right
defects.expected: The arm and hand visibly support or hug the stack of presents.

attempt.summary: Santa in a red suit rides a red kick scooter at night, with a brown sack of presents behind him on the deck, under a moon over snow, captioned 'Santa on a Scooter'; the drawing is clean and flat but the arms are simplified and stiff.

defects.what: Both arms are drawn as one thick red band coming out of the chest, so there are no separate arms and no shoulders.
defects.where: Santa's arms reaching to the handlebar
defects.expected: Two distinct arms, each attached at a shoulder, each ending in a hand gripping one side of the handlebar.

defects.what: The face is very small and plain, with a tiny beard and hardly any features, so it reads less clearly as Santa than the rest of the costume.
defects.expected: A clearly drawn Santa face with a full white beard and readable features.

defects.what: The sack's flat bottom overlaps the end of the deck, so it looks pasted on instead of sitting on the deck.
defects.where: the sack at the back of the scooter
defects.expected: The sack rests firmly on the deck or is clearly tied to the scooter.

defects.what: Santa and the scooter fill only a modest part of the frame, and the caption box at the bottom pulls attention from the scene.
defects.where: overall framing and the bottom caption
defects.expected: The rider and scooter are larger and centred so they clearly dominate the picture.

defects.what: The hat's white brim looks slightly separate from the hat and head, like a floating strip.
defects.expected: The brim fits snugly where the hat meets the head.
